subject: Auto Body Repairs and Spray Painting
sourceFile: Technical & Trade -- AUTO BODY REPAIRS AND SPRAY PAINTING.txt
examFormat: Three papers, all compulsory; Papers 1 and 2 are taken at one sitting. Paper 1: forty multiple-choice questions in 1 hour for 40 marks. Paper 2: five essay questions, answer any four, in 1 1/2 hours for 60 marks. Paper 3: practical test of 3 hours 10 minutes, one compulsory question for 100 marks; if materials cannot be acquired, a theoretical alternative of one question in 3 hours for 100 marks may be set.

topics.name: Safety Rules and Regulations in Auto Body Repairs and Spray Painting
objectives: Define safety rules and regulations in auto body repairs and spray painting
List the rules and regulations and their importance
List safety tools and equipment/machines for auto body repairs
Describe the auto body dress code and personal protective equipment (nose mask, goggles, boots, ear defender, etc.)
Identify sources of accident (human factors, machinery/equipment and workshop keeping) and their prevention
State the factory acts on safety: 1984 amended resource conservation recovery act, environmental protection agency regulations and hazardous waste collection and recycling (solvent recovery system)
topics.content: Practical: identification and use of safety tools, equipment and protective dress; identification of containers for hazardous waste; demonstration of horse play; reporting faulty machines/equipment; demonstration of workshop keeping, e.g. cleaning oil and water from the floor with saw dust and dry sand.

topics.name: Tools and Equipment
objectives: Identify the types of hand tools (hammers, dollies, spanner, files, ratchets, body spoons, etc.) and their uses
Identify the types and uses of power tools and equipment/machines (drilling machine, body jack, sanders, air compressor, shaping machines, cutting machine, etc.)
State the advantages and disadvantages of machines
State the uses of machines and safety precautions
Identify spray painting tools and equipment (scrapers, brushes, funnels, paint pots, spray gun, spray body filters, air compressor, oven, spray booth, etc.)
Define maintenance and its types: predictive, preventive and corrective
Use the manufacturer's maintenance guide
Maintain tools and equipment
topics.content: Practical: identification of hand tools, power tools and spray painting tools; demonstration of machine use; dismantling and assembly of a spray gun; cleaning of tools and equipment.

topics.name: Materials for Auto Body Repairs and Spray Painting
objectives: Identify the types of body filler: plastic filler, fibreglass fillers, body solder 30/70 and 40/60
Identify body abrasives, e.g. sand papers (wet and dry), sanding disc
Identify types of sealers, e.g. rubber sealers, seam sealers, undercoating
Identify rivet pins, e.g. pop and solid rivets
Identify types of paints: enamel paints and lacquers
Distinguish under coats (surface primer, putty/body filler, sealers) from top coats (lacquers and enamel paints)
Use the manufacturer's paint guide: paint formula, paint mixing equipment, custom-mix base colours, paint labels, colour charts
topics.content: Practical: identification of body fillers and abrasives; use of the rivet gun; identification of paints by use of thinner; demonstration of under coats and top coats; mixing paints; identification of colours using colour charts.

topics.name: Types of Metals
objectives: Distinguish ferrous and non-ferrous metals (mild steel, cast iron, aluminium, brass, etc.)
State the properties of metals: fusibility, malleability, ductility, weldability, etc.
State the uses of metals on auto bodies
topics.content: Practical: identification of ferrous and non-ferrous metals; demonstration of properties of metals.

topics.name: Heat Treatment of Metals
objectives: Define heat treatment
Describe the types and process of heat treatment, e.g. hardening, annealing, normalizing, case-hardening and tempering
State the importance of heat treatment
topics.content: Practical: demonstration of heat treatment processes.

topics.name: Oxy-Acetylene Welding and Equipment
objectives: Define oxy-acetylene welding
State safety precautions
Identify oxy-acetylene welding equipment
Describe the types of oxy-acetylene gas system used (high and low pressure)
Describe installation of welding equipment
Identify welding nozzles
Identify defects of oxy-acetylene welding (slag inclusion, porosity, crack, lack of penetration, etc.) and their remedies
topics.content: Practical: identification of equipment; use of high and low pressure systems; assembling and installing welding equipment; identification of weld defects.

subtopics.name: Minor auto body repair
objectives: Identify the types of auto body: integral body and composite body

Describe basic methods of straightening auto body: aligning the metal with power jack, pulling with sledge hammer, using pry-bar, pulling with pull taps, heat-shrinking the metal back to its original shape
Identify tools used in minor repairs: hammers, hand dollies, spoons, spanners, screw drivers, etc.

subtopics.name: Major auto body repair
objectives: Identify major body sections, e.g. front engine compartment, passenger section, rear section
State the basic alignment principle
Describe quarter panel cutting
Describe light weight panels
Identify damaged vehicle alignment tools

topics.name: Aluminium Panel Repair
objectives: State the steps involved in aluminium panel repair
Repair and align a damaged aluminium panel
Describe aluminium deck lid repair
topics.content: Practical: demonstration of repair and alignment of an aluminium panel; aluminium deck lid repair procedure.

topics.name: Plastic Repairs
objectives: State precautions while working with plastics
Distinguish types of plastic resins (thermosetting and thermoplastic)
Repair plastic parts by melting
Describe glass fibre panel repair (introduction)
topics.content: Practical: identification of plastics; demonstration of repair of plastic parts by melting.

topics.name: Spray Painting
topics.content: Practical: identification of pressure feed, siphon and gravity guns; preparation of metal surfaces for spray painting; identification of paints used on auto bodies; demonstration of metallic spray techniques.

subtopics.name: Spray gun and accessories
objectives: Identify the spray gun types: pressure feed gun, siphon and gravity gun
Identify spray gun parts: air cap, fluid needle, air valve, trigger, gun body, cup, etc.
State precautions in the use of the spray gun
Use the manufacturer's maintenance guide

objectives: Prepare surfaces for spray painting

objectives: Identify paints used on auto bodies: cellulose synthetic paint, enamel paint, acrylic, metallic paints, etc.
State the importance of the manufacturer's paint code

subtopics.name: Metallic paint
objectives: Identify variable agents (flakes and pigments)
Describe metallic spray techniques (wet and dry spray)

objectives: State factors to consider in locating an auto body repair shop: capital, accessibility, land, etc.
